authority.document_title: Report on the Proposed Budget Ceiling for Constituencies for the Financial Year 2025/2026
authority.table: Table 3 — grand allocation by number of wards per constituency

derivation.rule: Count each constituency's canonical child wards in the Atlas electoral registry, then apply the exact FY2025/26 Parliament-approved budget ceiling published for that ward-count class.
prohibited: manual constituency overrides without a new official source contract

acceptance: Canonical registry contains exactly 290 constituencies and 1,450 wards.
Every ward has exactly one canonical constituency parent for this derivation.
The canonical constituency ward-count distribution exactly matches Parliament Table 3: 21/79/106/54/23/7 for 3–8 wards.
Exactly 290 FY2025/26 allocation observations are generated for the governed IND-NG-CDF-ALLOCATION slot.
All observations are marked derived from an official formula and carry badge B, not direct badge A.
No county value is inherited or manufactured.
